one_liner_zh: 漢威聯合EPS溫和超預期，多角化工業組合維持穩定獲利。
one_liner_en: Honeywell modestly beat EPS, with the diversified industrial portfolio sustaining steady earnings.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS 2.59略高於預期2.54（+2.14%），表現穩健。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：2.14%小幅超標屬穩健執行，符合多角化工業集團穩定獲利特性。短期股價以分拆價值釋放與穩定現金流為支撐，缺乏營收年增資料使成長判讀保守。中期關鍵在投資組合重組與航太動能延續。追蹤指標：航太有機營收與利潤率、短週期事業訂單動能、分拆進度、調整後營業利潤率，以及全年EPS與營收指引方向。
ai_view_en: Signal is neutral-to-positive: a modest 2.14% beat reflects steady execution consistent with a diversified industrial conglomerate. Near-term, spin-off value-unlock and stable cash flow anchor the stock, while the missing revenue YoY keeps the growth read conservative. Mid-term, portfolio restructuring and aerospace momentum continuity are key. Track: aerospace organic revenue and margins, short-cycle business order momentum, spin-off progress, adjusted operating margin, and the direction of full-year EPS and revenue guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.59美元，略高於預期2.54美元，正向驚喜2.14%
營收68.6億美元，營運規模穩定
航太與自動化多角化組合提供獲利韌性
分拆與投資組合優化聚焦長期成長
highlights_en: EPS of $2.59 came in slightly above the $2.54 estimate, a 2.14% positive surprise
Revenue of $6.86B reflects a stable operating base
Diversified aerospace and automation portfolio provides earnings resilience
Spin-offs and portfolio optimization focus on long-term growth
risks_zh: 營收年增資料缺失，成長趨勢判讀受限
短週期工業事業需求疲弱風險
本益比36.67在溫和成長下缺乏評價彈性
risks_en: Missing revenue YoY limits the read on growth trends
Soft demand risk in short-cycle industrial businesses
A 36.67x P/E offers limited valuation flexibility amid modest growth
